Determine the surface area of the above cylinder.
question.worked_solution:
We can calculate the surface area of a cylinder using the formula

$$
S = 2\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh,
$$

where $r$ is the radius and $h$ is the height of the cylinder.

Substituting $r=3 \,\textrm{in}$ and $h=9\,\textrm{in}$ into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}S & =2\pi (3)^{2}+2\pi (3)(9) \\  & =18\pi +54\pi  \\  & =72\pi \,{\text{in}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
